name: pUSD token catalog (Portaldot V3 testnet, consumer v2)

reviewer.control: the project's separate reviewer test account (5DtqFzALznihBAE5wWmWJ1owZcFbiUX6hYKcvAZyt3sSUDjZ), funded from the development account on 2026-10-25; a distinct signer controlled by the same project, so this shows role separation, not independent review

policy.name: pUSD catalog policy (testnet, consumer v2, separate reviewer)

reviewers.basis: The project's separate reviewer test account. The release owner's own approval does not count under this policy. Both accounts are controlled by the project, so this demonstrates role separation on-chain, not independent review; a production catalog would name reviewers it does not control.

supersededPolicies.note: The first v2 policy (2026-10-24) trusted the owner account as its reviewer and named the pusd-token-list release; its binding of the v1 report was never listed on v2. Superseded on 2026-10-25 by this role-separated policy on the pusd-catalog-v2 release. The binding is kept as history.
